items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling (scan, check oil, timing and sensors)
items.note: Cost depends on what is found; parts range covers a sensor or solenoid. Low oil or timing chain wear costs much more.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace pistons and rings after oil consumption test
items.note: Ask the dealer about goodwill help first. A used engine is an alternative if the engine is badly worn; one owner was quoted $9,500 for a new engine.

items.t: Plugged crankcase vent causes oil use and leaks
items.job: Clear PCV passage or replace intake manifold
items.note: Check first whether GM special coverage 14882 still applies to your VIN.

items.t: Timing chain stretch and rattle
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: If the chain jumped and bent valves, cylinder head work can push the total past $1,500.

items.t: Check engine light from camshaft timing solenoid
items.job: Replace camshaft position actuator solenoid

items.t: Coolant leak from water pump, pipes or radiator
items.job: Replace water pump (or leaking coolant pipe/radiator)
items.note: A radiator replacement runs about $900 at a shop; a coolant pipe is usually less.

items.t: Carbon buildup causes rough idle and misfires
items.job: Walnut-blast clean intake valves

items.t: Steering sticks or feels notchy near center
items.job: Replace or repair electric power steering gear
items.note: Check first whether GM special coverage 14232 still applies; the repair may be free.

items.t: Clicking, clunking or shudder when shifting
items.job: Diagnose transmission, update software, check axles and mounts
items.note: Owners report dealers often find nothing wrong. Internal transmission repair would cost much more.

items.t: Clear coat peeling
items.job: Refinish affected panels (roof, hood, trunk)
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,700.

items.t: Heater or A/C works only some of the time
items.job: Diagnose climate control; replace blend door actuator or blower part

items.t: Battery drains and car won't start
items.job: Battery test, parasitic draw test and battery replacement
items.note: If a module is causing the drain, that part adds to the cost.

items.t: Blind spot modules fail and set many warnings
items.job: Replace side blind zone alert module(s)
items.note: Owners paid about $1,340 for both sides; a used module costs much less.

items.t: Check engine light and trouble filling the gas tank
items.job: Smoke test EVAP system and replace vent valve or hose

items.t: Windshield fogs with heavy moisture
items.job: Check A/C drain, cabin filter and door seals

items.t: Parking brake warning light from a failed module or switch
items.job: Replace parking brake switch or control module and repair wiring
items.note: One owner paid about $1,450 including over 3 hours of wiring repair.

items.t: Drive belt or tensioner noise
items.job: Replace serpentine belt and tensioner

items.t: Driver airbag may not deploy (recalls)
items.job: Replace steering wheel airbag coil (recalls 12V-522, 13V-023, 14V-300)

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can explode (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module (recall 23V-516)

items.t: Roof-rail side airbag inflator can rupture (recalls)
items.job: Replace roof-rail airbag modules (recalls 23V-674, 23V-870, 25V-764)

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace key cylinder lock housing (recall 16V-502)

items.t: Shift cable can disconnect (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace shift cable adjuster (recall 14V-092)

items.t: Block heater cord can crack in the cold (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater cord (recall 14V-417)

items.t: Fuel line can rub the engine and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel line assembly (recall 16V-595)
